About Occibo
 Occibo is an AI-powered SaaS platform for children's book creation, built by IndieKidz GmbH in Berlin. We are a small, remote-first team looking for a QA Engineer to help us build and maintain automated testing so we can ship new features quickly and with confidence.
 Employment type 
 Full-time position.
 Salary: up to INR 3.5 lakhs per year
 Tasks
 What you will do:

• Build end-to-end UI test automation for the Occibo web app

• Write test plans, test cases, and regression suites for core user flows

• Translate product requirements into automated checks, including edge cases

• Collaborate with the development team on test data strategies and stable selectors

• Add API level tests to support UI testing and improve overall reliability

• Run tests in CI pipelines, track failures, and help keep the test suite stable and maintainable

• Use AI tools to speed up test creation, analysis, and maintenance

• Document testing processes, findings, and quality recommendations

 Tools you will work with
 Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, Vitest, GitHub Actions, Postman 
 Requirements
 We are looking for:

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience in software testing or QA automation

• Experience with at least one test automation framework — Playwright or Cypress preferred

• Comfortable with JavaScript or TypeScript and Git

• Understanding of CI pipelines and reliable test design

• Experience using AI tools in a testing or development workflow

• Fluent English

• Comfortable working in EU time zones or with significant overlap during European business hours

• Motivated to work in an early-stage startup environment where things move fast and ownership is expected

 Nice to have

• Prior SaaS UI automation experience

• API testing experience with Postman or REST clients

• Based in Indonesia or able to work in the Indonesia time zone

 Benefits

• Compensation (Salary: up to INR 3.5 lakhs per year) 

• Fully remote and flexible working environment

• Hands-on experience with a real AI-powered product from the ground up 

• Direct collaboration with the founder and development team 

• A portfolio of shipped QA work you can show future employers 

• Long-term engagement with real growth potential as the product scales 

• Be part of building something meaningful from an early stage 

 How to apply
 Send a message with your CV, a cover letter including your salary expectation , your best project link, the test framework you know best, and your availability and start date.
 We are looking for candidates available to start as soon as possible.
